Nobody can make an assistant recommend a: Nobody can make an assistant recommend a business. This kit measures what assistants say and fixes what you own: your pages and your files.
Google says you need no special markup,: Google says you need no special markup, AI text files or pages written for AI to appear in its AI answers, and that Google Search ignores llms.txt (Google's AI optimization guide, last updated 10 July 2026).
A study of about 300,000 domains (SE Ran: A study of about 300,000 domains (SE Ranking, November 2025) found no measurable link between having an llms.txt and being cited. It is cheap tidiness, not a lever.
Google retired the FAQ rich result on 7: Google retired the FAQ rich result on 7 May 2026, so FAQ markup earns no special listing there. The questions and answers on the page itself still help readers and assistants.
Answers change from run to run: a study: Answers change from run to run: a study by SparkToro and Gumshoe (January 2026) found AI tools gave the same list of brands less than 1 in 100 times. That is why every rate here is a count over several runs, with its sample size.
The test shows whether rates changed, ne: The test shows whether rates changed, never why. A page going live and a change in rates can happen together by chance.
Vercel and MERJ reported in December 202: Vercel and MERJ reported in December 2024 that the major AI crawlers they measured did not run scripts, with Google's Gemini (through Googlebot) and Apple's crawler the exceptions. That finding is nearly two years old; treat it as a reason to check, not a fact about today.
